title: Minimum Payment Misconception

scenes.text: Paying $200 monthly on a $2,000 credit card balance?
scenes.query: credit card statement showing balance and payment

scenes.text: Most people believe that paying only the minimum due keeps them from paying interest.
scenes.label: Only Minimum Needed

scenes.text: Credit cards calculate interest on the full balance; the minimum payment just slows the payoff and adds months of interest.
scenes.label: Interest Still Accrues

scenes.text: Pay more than the minimum each month to cut interest dramatically.
scenes.label: Pay More

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: Most think the minimum payment protects them from interest—it's the opposite. Learn the real impact in seconds.
